name: Crown Paint Prep (Post-Primer)
intent: Inspect cured primer, light sand, touch up caulk/fill, clean dust before finish. Mirrors MOD_PREP_TRIM_PAINT at identical rates; reads PS_SURFACE_LF.TRIM_CROWN.
doctrine: 1:1 mirror of MOD_PREP_TRIM_PAINT against crown LF. Rates match trim counterpart per extraction pattern.
